_comment: Responses ACTUALLY OBSERVED from these two URLs on 2026-08-03, recorded so the fixture is deterministic and needs no network. Rule 2: the fires-correctly case derives from a real regression, not a model of one. The third entry is the soft-404 branch: a 200 that serves HTML where the path states .pdf, which is how a removed document reads as a present one. The last two are recorded as HTTP 200 deliberately: they ARE reachable, and the point is that reachability is not the test - a search interface is not the document a record cites, so the check must reject them on shape before it ever fetches.
